Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill because I could use the small propane tanks.  I am 76 years old and no longer able to lift heavy propane tanks.  The grill does a great job.  The size is perfect for just myself and sometimes a few friends.  I gave a low rating because of the customer service.  I disconnected an almost full tank for the winter.  I had used it twice.  I was unable to reattach it to use the remaining fuel.  After requesting help with the problem, a very disrespectful service rep, told me that if the tank went on once it should go back on again.  This has not proved to be true with several different tanks from different manufactures.  It is difficult and awkward to install the propane tank and the tank should NOT be removed unless it is empty.  Removing seems to cross thread the connector so that a previously partially used tank cannot be reinstalled.
Results.Title: Customer Service is not helpful

Results.ReviewText: I love my grill. My new one. Last died but Weber tried to help fix. Love this grill.
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText: Great cooker. Gets hot fast and cooks very evenly across grill. You will not be disappointed with this purchase.
Results.Title: Excellent cooking machine

Results.ReviewText: Excellent small BBQ. Easy to assemble and to transport. Sturdy. Cooks very evenly.
Results.Title: Weber Portable Grill

Results.ReviewText: Grill cooks evenly and the temp so far has been able to be adjusted pretty good although I haven't had the need to cook at lower temps so I don't know how low the heat goes with the burner on low and the lid closed. I purchased the Cart/Stand with this and glad I did but the cart/stand is a little wobbly especially when brushing the grate after use. My real interest will be in how long this lasts. I take care of my grills and if I don't have to replace any parts for 5+ years, I will be really impressed! I have only had 1 other grill that lasted and it was a Coleman. I ponied up the extra $$ for this Weber so I expect this to last for years!
Results.Title: New Weber customer

Results.ReviewText: I bought the grill as a bday gift for my husband and he loves it. Almost every time he uses it he tells me how much he likes it.

Results.ReviewText:
This is an awesome little grill.  Great for a small family or couple to make dinner.

The only charges in design would be that the side tables be made of metal rather than plastic to avoid the potential of them melting.  I am not real familiar with all the gas grills available on the market but having one designed to allow a means to easily clean the inside would be great, whether using foil or disconnecting the burner to easily clean the drippings from the inside.

This model is a really good product and we will enjoy using it for years to come!!
Results.Title: Weber 1200 Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: We've had Weber products for over thirty years when we owned a house. Now we full-time RV and finally switched to a Weber Q and it’s like I’m back at my house grilling on the patio. Easy to use, easy to store and setup is a breeze. Everything I grill turns out great. I wonder why it took so long to get one.

Results.ReviewText: This is our third Weber  Q1200.  We use it 3-4 times a week, and although it appears small, and takes up very little space, and we can cook enough hamburgers for a family get-together. It is economic since a propane tank lasts about 6 months - even with almost daily use.
